author: ZimaOS Team
description: Frigate is an open-source network video recorder (NVR) with real-time AI object detection. It provides local, private camera recording, event review, snapshots, and live viewing through a web interface.
tagline: Monitor your security cameras with locally processed AI
title: Frigate
release_note:
- Frigate 0.17.2 is a maintenance release with security and stability fixes.
- Fixes a go2rtc command-prefix bypass that could lead to remote code execution and container escape (CVE-2026-25643).
- Fixes an admin response cache leak and incorrect cache-control headers for current-hour preview MP4 files.
